jurisdiction.venue: U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York & SEC

headline: Shopping App’s ‘Proprietary Neural Network’ Was Actually a Night Shift in Manila, Prosecutors Say
deck: Albert Saniger raised more than $42 million pitching Nate, Inc. as 93 to 97 percent automated by artificial intelligence; federal filings allege the true automation rate was near zero.
byline: By The Financial Crimes Technology Desk

street_crime_compare.exec_summary: Criminal indictment and SEC civil suit pending trial in SDNY over $42M+ raised on alleged 93–97% AI automation claims.
street_crime_compare.street_equivalent: Selling a $1,800 counterfeit watch on a street corner
street_crime_compare.street_sentence: Misdemeanor or felony fraud booking without $42M in venture-capital diligence memos
